No top-level commands or substitutions (like `$(curl ...)`, `eval`, or backticks) are present that could lead to arbitrary code execution when the file is sourced.

Therefore, running `makepkg --printsrcinfo` on this PKGBUILD is safe, as it will only parse metadata without triggering any harmful actions.
